title: technique profile
description: the rules describing what a technique profile json file must contain. the technique profile holds a department's settings for one x-ray projection. this schema is the contract between the editing agent and the runtime engine: if a profile violates these rules, the engine refuses to load it. all distances are in centimeters, all angles in degrees.

projection.description: the shorthand name of the projection this profile applies to, for example chest-pa or pelvis-ap. unique across profiles.

view.description: the full radiography name of the view, for example chest posteroanterior or pelvis anteroposterior.

centering.description: where the central ray must pass through the patient.

landmark.description: the anatomical landmark the central ray targets, for example t7 for chest pa or the iliac crest for pelvis ap.

landmark_offset_cm.description: the position on the detector plane where the central ray should land, as an offset from the detector center. not a source-to-image distance.

vertical_cm.description: offset in centimeters along the patient's long axis. negative means toward the feet, positive means toward the head.

horizontal_cm.description: offset in centimeters across the patient. negative means to one side, positive to the other, relative to the detector center.

collimation_bounds_cm.description: how far the light field may extend beyond the anatomy in each direction before the image is judged cut off.

superior_cm.description: allowable light-field extent above the anatomy in centimeters.

inferior_cm.description: allowable light-field extent below the anatomy in centimeters.

left_cm.description: allowable light-field extent on one side in centimeters.

right_cm.description: allowable light-field extent on the other side in centimeters.

rotation.description: how much the patient may rotate before the image is judged unacceptable.

max_yaw_degrees.description: the maximum rotation around the patient's long axis, in degrees, before the copilot flags it.

symmetry_check.description: which visible anatomical pairs the copilot measures for symmetry, for example sternoclavicular-joints for chest pa or iliac-wings for pelvis ap.

inspiration.description: only for projections where breath-hold depth matters, like chest views. null when it does not apply.

target.description: the desired breath state, for example full inspiration.

method.description: how the copilot measures it from the camera, for example chest wall expansion during the breath hold.

exposure.description: how thickness maps to exposure settings. the points are the department's own calibrated values, entered once. the engine interpolates linearly between them for any measured thickness.

points.description: calibration points. each pair says: at this measured thickness in centimeters, use this kvp and this mas.

kvp.description: peak kilovoltage setting at this thickness.

grid.description: true when the room uses a grid (a device that blocks scattered x-rays) for this projection, which changes the needed exposure.

target_exposure_index.description: the acceptable range for the detector's exposure index. used only as a quality check after exposure, never as the recommendation target.
